SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DISTINCT BUYER, DOC_NO FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PR_SEND WHERE BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'LTCO') AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT DOC_NO TRANSACTION_ID, BUYER, DOC_NO, DOC_SEQ, LEGACY_USER_ID, BUYER_ITEM_NO, ITEM_QTY, SUBSTR(DESCRIPTION,0,50) AS DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_PRICE, ITEM_AMT, UNIT_MEASURE, PLANT FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PR_SEND WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND DOC_NO = '$G_RS.DOC_NO$' ORDER BY BUYER, DOC_NO, DOC_SEQ
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_PR_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND DOC_NO = '$G_RS.DOC_NO$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_PR_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND DOC_NO = '$G_RS.DOC_NO$'
